name: sales-support
title: Sales, support and customer success
summary: Win customers and keep them: prospecting and outreach, discovery calls and demos, proposals and contracts, procurement and security questionnaires, onboarding, support operations, customer success and churn, and reviews.
useWhen: Write a cold email or build a prospect list
Prepare for a discovery call or product demo
A prospect sent a security questionnaire or wants us in their vendor portal
Write a proposal or statement of work, or respond to redlines on our contract
Set up customer support: inbox, help center, response targets and escalation
A customer is angry or asking for a refund; how do I respond?
Customers are churning; how do I find out why and stop it?
Run kickoff, data import and training for a newly signed business customer
Decide what an internal admin tool must let support do without an engineer
We got a bad public review

notFor.topic: Positioning, landing pages, launches and inbound marketing
List prices, plans and discount policy

DPAs, terms of service and compliance certifications themselves
Retention metrics, cohorts and churn analysis
